summary: Silent-ignore cohort reached 10 closed-window predictions with no dome-posted result — predictions section needs a one-time aggregation prose block + table
detail: Cohort (all past test_window_closes, dome page still shows pending/no result, not in status_history.json): PRED-087, PRED-088, PRED-111, PRED-085, PRED-077, PRED-090, PRED-081, PRED-106 (closed 2026-04-30), PRED-105 (closed 2026-04-18, tacit_withdrawal), PRED-073 (closed 2026-05-31, falsified, d=8 silence as of 2026-06-08). sections.json contains no dedicated prose on this pattern. Proposed fix: new short subsection in the predictions part of sections.json — punchline: the dome's scoreboard records hits and never records misses; predictions that fail are neither confirmed, refuted, nor retracted — they simply stop being mentioned, while the WIN counter keeps climbing. Include a compact table of the 10 entries (ID, claim one-liner, window-close date, dome status, our verdict) computed/cross-checked from data/predictions.json, plus the CHAOS-8 verification caveat for PRED-073 (our verdict rests on the secular-rate null — honest-scoring contrast). Also standardize author_status for 14+-day silences to 'silent_ignore_confirmed' (9 of 10 still say 'pending'). Routed as expansion EXP-605 (tracker entry created this run).
